headerDisplay: Controls Poplight Bluetooth wall sconces directly over BLE. Quit the official Poplight app (and the Poplight Mac app) while Homebridge is running: each light accepts a single connection.

autoDiscover.title: Auto-discover lights
autoDiscover.description: Add every light advertising as POP_Light that comes into range.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: On demand connects to a light when a command is sent and lets go after an idle period, which keeps the lights' standby battery life. The first command after idle takes a few seconds. Persistent holds a connection to every light for instant response, at a heavy cost in battery (roughly half a charge per day in testing).

idleDisconnectSeconds.title: Idle disconnect (seconds)
idleDisconnectSeconds.description: On demand only: how long the connection is kept after the last command, so follow-up adjustments are instant.

batteryPollMinutes.title: Battery poll interval (minutes)
batteryPollMinutes.description: How often to ask each light for its battery level. Defaults to 60 on demand, where each poll is a short connection, and 5 with a persistent connection. The level is also read whenever a light is connected for a command.

lowBatteryThreshold.title: Low battery threshold (%)
lowBatteryThreshold.description: At or below this level the light is flagged as low battery. The light reports 25/50/75/100.

batterySensor.title: Battery level tile
batterySensor.description: Add a '<light> Battery' humidity-style sensor per light so the percentage shows on its own tile in Home.

lowBatterySensor.title: Battery Low contact sensor
lowBatterySensor.description: Add a '<light> Battery Low' contact sensor per light. It opens at the threshold, so Home can send a notification and automations can react.

lights.title: Lights
lights.description: Optional names for specific lights. With auto-discover off, only these lights are added.

id.title: Peripheral id
id.description: As logged by the plugin when the light is discovered (UUID on macOS, MAC address on Linux).

bindings.title: Bluetooth bindings
bindings.description: Which noble driver to use. 'default' picks the platform driver (CoreBluetooth on macOS, raw HCI socket on Linux). Use 'hci' explicitly inside Docker on Linux, or 'dbus' to go through BlueZ.
